title: Side open space by building type, residential buildings up to 12.5 m
source: MP Bhumi Vikas Rules 2012, consolidated to 06-03-2025, English PDF

detached.row_text: (i) For detached buildings there shall be minimum side open spaces of 3 meters on both the sides :

relaxation.row_text: Provided that for detached residential building up to 7 meters in height on plots with a frontage less than 12 meters, one of the sides open space may be reduced to 1.5 meters.

semi_detached.row_text: (ii) For semi-detached building there shall be a minimum side open space of 3.0 meters on one side.

relaxation.row_text: For Semi-detached building up to 10 meters in height on plots with a frontage up to 10 meters, the side open space may be reduced to 2.5 meters.

row.row_text: (iii) For row-type buildings, no side open space is required.
